summary: First iteration testing (frontend + backend) for Rasio Elektrifikasi Murung Raya admin panel. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passing (auth, periods, dashboard TW I 37,041 & TW II 36,800, kecamatan/desa/households CRUD-read, users CRUD, periods CRUD, settings, upload preview + bad-file rejection). Frontend: login (wrong password error + successful redirect), Dashboard KPIs match backend numbers (total_rt 36,800; RE 91.20%; delta -0.03%), all three charts (proporsi, kecamatan, trend) render, period selector switches to TW I and updates total_rt to 37,041. Navigation works across all 8 pages. Kecamatan lists 10 rows and search filters correctly (Murung -> 2 rows), CSV export button clickable. Upload flow: file upload -> validation summary + preview table + Simpan button all render; commit was rejected with 400 only because default form period (TW I) was locked, which is correct behavior. All data-testids referenced in the spec are present and functional.

issues: Text content of kpi-total-rt and kpi-rasio-elektrifikasi concatenates all descendant text (e.g. '36.800Total Rumah Tangga10 Kecamatan · 125 Desa/Kel'). Rendering is visually fine but makes automated assertions harder; consider wrapping the numeric value in its own data-testid (e.g. kpi-total-rt-value).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_user builds '$inc' as an empty dict when no password change is provided. MongoDB rejects '$inc: {}' in some versions; safer to conditionally include the $inc operator only when password is being rotated.
seed_admin only resets password when hash differs; consider also resetting token_version so an active session is not silently kept across a password reset (spec expected behavior).

Auth cookies use samesite='none' + secure=True which is correct for cross-origin preview, but there is no CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints. Bearer token in localStorage ('re_token') is already used by frontend, so cookie path is largely redundant.
No brute-force lockout implemented for /api/auth/login (spec mentioned 5-fail lockout). Currently only returns 401 forever.
forgot-password / password-reset flow not implemented (spec mentions sha256 token_hash and identical response for known/unknown emails).

CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' in .env combined with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo. It happens to work only because backend also accepts Bearer tokens. Should be an explicit origin.
Upload commit deletes all existing kecamatan for the period then re-inserts — data loss if request payload is empty/partial. Consider wrapping in a transaction or backing up prior rows.
Dashboard KPI card component concatenates all inner text into the labeled data-testid; suggest a dedicated child testid for the numeric value.
Kecamatan row testids use r.no from DB — if any seeded row is missing 'no' the testid becomes kec-row-undefined.
seed_data_creation: None — used auto-seeded TW I 2026 (37,041 RT) and TW II 2026 (36,800 RT) plus 756 households from seed_data.json.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Period kode format is 'TW1-2026' / 'TW2-2026' (arabic numerals) but frontend labels and dashboard trend use roman ('TW I 2026'). Upload input has data-testid='upload-input' but is hidden — use state='attached' with set_input_files. TW I is locked by default so upload/commit against triwulan=I returns 400 which is correct.
